extDescription.message: Pick an element, get every similar one as a table. Test XPath, copy to Sheets or CSV. No site access, no tracking, open source.

pickHint.message: Click the button, then click an item on the page. Similar items become rows.

pickActive.message: Now click an item on the page. Press Esc to cancel.

copiedTsv.message: Copied. Paste into Google Sheets or Excel.

empty.message: No rows yet. Pick an element, or type an XPath and press Scrape.

errColumns.message: Some column XPaths have errors (marked red). Those cells are empty.

errNoRows.message: Type a rows XPath or pick an element first.

errNothing.message: Nothing to copy yet. Press Scrape first.

errRestricted.message: Chrome does not let extensions read this page (Chrome pages and the Web Store). Try another site.

errTabGone.message: The tab was closed or changed. Click the Honest Scraper icon on the page again.

errNoAccess.message: Access ended because the page changed. Click the Honest Scraper icon on the page again.

trust.message: Reads only the tab you opened it from, only when you click. Nothing leaves your browser.
